key_idea: All lawns are the same size, so the biggest sand patch leaves the least grass.
steps: All five lawns are the same size. Each has a sand patch in the middle with no grass.
The more sand, the less grass. So look for the biggest sand patch.
The patch in D is as tall as the tallest patch and wider than all the others. Every other patch would fit inside it.
So lawn D has the least grass.

choice_feedback.A: Lawn A has the smallest sand patch, so it has the most grass.
choice_feedback.B: The sand patch in B is smaller than the one in D, so B has more grass.
choice_feedback.C: The sand patch in C is as tall as the one in D, but thinner, so C has more grass.
choice_feedback.E: The sand patch in E is a bit smaller than the one in D, so E has more grass.
